title: Sketch for Procession by Haag
content: In this preparatory sketch of a wedding procession by Carl Haag, the top horizontal line is the eye level.Sketch for 'A Bridal Procession at Damascus,' 1892 by Carl HaasEvery figure is placed relation to the height of the viewer. Assuming a level ground plane, the eye level intersects the camel riders in the middle of their chests, and it's about half a figure higher than the top of a standing figure.
